SELECT
    cr.change_request_id,
    cr.change_request_code,
    cr.project_id,
    p.project_code,
    p.project_name,

    cr.change_title,
    cr.requested_by,
    cr.requested_date,
    cr.priority,
    cr.change_status,
    cr.requested_completion_date,

    latest_assessment.assessment_id,
    latest_assessment.schedule_rating,
    latest_assessment.cost_rating,
    latest_assessment.resource_rating,
    latest_assessment.technical_rating,
    latest_assessment.risk_rating,
    latest_assessment.overall_impact,
    latest_assessment.recommendation,
    latest_assessment.assessed_at

FROM change_requests cr

JOIN projects p
    ON p.project_id = cr.project_id

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        cia.assessment_id,
        cia.schedule_rating,
        cia.cost_rating,
        cia.resource_rating,
        cia.technical_rating,
        cia.risk_rating,
        cia.overall_impact,
        cia.recommendation,
        cia.assessed_at
    FROM change_impact_assessments cia
    WHERE cia.change_request_id = cr.change_request_id
    ORDER BY cia.assessed_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) latest_assessment
    ON TRUE

ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC;
